title: Make "INFO: Pump unreachable" notification actionable?
body:
As a user, I would like to be able to tap the "INFO: Pump Unreachable" notification that pops up and go directly to the "Medtronic" tab view.

I can see the `PumpUnreachable` `MedtronicNotificationType` here: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/bc43a926f9fce29eb3f3c262b4b6e955da088962/medtronic/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/plugins/pump/medtronic/defs/MedtronicNotificationType.java#L12 is used here: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/bc43a926f9fce29eb3f3c262b4b6e955da088962/medtronic/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/plugins/pump/medtronic/MedtronicPumpPlugin.java#L475 and here: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/bc43a926f9fce29eb3f3c262b4b6e955da088962/medtronic/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/plugins/pump/medtronic/MedtronicPumpPlugin.java#L570, but not being an app developer, I'm not sure how to add an intent to the dismiss/tap action. Possibly a check in https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/bc43a926f9fce29eb3f3c262b4b6e955da088962/medtronic/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/plugins/pump/medtronic/util/MedtronicUtil.java#L235-L237?

comments.body:
Notifications are just that... Notifications. They give you information, and then you can go and do something. 

Pump Unrechable notification is displayed when command can't be sent to pump.
 
Most of commands, will be retried automatically in 5 minutes (when next CGMS data comes in)...

I've also wondered why I cannot tap on the notification and get at least straight into AAPS. That kind of breaks the typical Android behaviour. Getting straight into the Medtronic tab would be even better.

Related, perhaps the notification can also be automatically dismissed when the pump is reachable again, similar to how https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/118 added automatic dismissal of some notifications.
